name: Adzhosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in the Shartegosuchidae, which has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Adzhosuchus is a shartegosuchid crocodyliform from the Late Jurassic of southwestern Mongolia.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
